title: Angular measures and uniform circular motion; Simple harmonic motion: definition and graphs
source: Questions copied unchanged from the mission-lesson scripts for Eduqas A-level Physics (status of the source: mission-lesson scripts of Oct-Nov 2026 (reviewed by AI reviewers; not signed off by a person)). Terms and clues: C01-1#t1 term and clue written for the game; O01-1#t4 term and clue written for the game; C01-1#t2 term and clue written for the game; O01-1#t2 term and clue written for the game. Questions: C01-1#N.4a, O01-1#N.10a, C01-1#N.12a, O01-1#N.11.

assemble.prompt: Match each term to its definition.

items.label: Period
items.clue: Time taken for one full revolution.

items.label: Amplitude
items.clue: Maximum displacement of an oscillating object.

items.label: Frequency
items.clue: Number of revolutions each second, measured in Hz.

items.label: Restoring force
items.clue: Always points back to equilibrium, opposite to the displacement.

questions.stem: A bicycle wheel of diameter 0.700 m rotates at a steady rate about a fixed axle, making one complete revolution every 0.250 s. What is the linear speed of a point on the rim of the wheel?
An object in SHM has a maximum speed v_max and a maximum acceleration of magnitude a_max. Which expression gives the period T of the motion?

The drum of a washing machine has a diameter of 0.50 m. It rotates about a horizontal axis at constant speed, with a time period of 0.050 s. What is the centripetal acceleration of a sock pressed against the inside of the drum?
A pendulum bob swings to and fro in a small arc. At the lowest point of its swing, what are its acceleration along its path and its speed?

options.text: Acceleration along the path greatest; speed zero.
Acceleration along the path zero; speed greatest.
Acceleration along the path zero; speed also zero.
Acceleration along the path greatest; speed greatest.

questions.explanation: The lowest point is equilibrium: the restoring force along the path is zero there. The bob sped up all the way down and starts to slow on the way up, so its speed is greatest here.
